mechanism: Cimetidine inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing lisdexamfetamine levels and amphetamine exposure; cimetidine also increases urinary pH which may decrease amphetamine renal clearance.
action: Monitor for increased stimulant effects (tachycardia, hypertension, insomnia, anxiety); consider alternative H2-antagonist (famotidine) or adjust lisdexamfetamine dose if necessary.
